title: Public and private
prompt: RSA uses a public key (n=3233, e=17) to encrypt. Letters are A=1..Z=26, each encrypted on its own. Knowing p=61 and q=53 lets you decrypt.
hint.1: Use the RSA tool with n=3233 and e=17.
hint.2: The tool factors n for you.
hint.3: Because n is tiny, anyone can factor it. Real RSA uses primes with hundreds of digits.
walkthrough: Decrypt each number: R, S, A.
